from pathlib import Path
import json,torch
from torch.nn import functional as F
from tf_sbir.retrieval_diagnosis import global_inputs,stratified_sample
from tf_sbir.foundation import load_words
from tf_sbir.semantic import read_words
from tf_sbir.reverse_prompt import nearest_words,term_average
w=Path('/content/sbir')
cfg,_,qs,_,gs,raw,rgb=global_inputs(w,'sketchy')
source,target=(t.cuda() for t in load_words(cfg,read_words(cfg.vocabulary))); pairs=source-target
within=pairs.T@pairs/len(pairs)
perm=torch.randperm(len(target),generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(751)).cuda()
wrong=source-target[perm]; wrong=wrong.T@wrong/len(wrong)
out={}
with torch.inference_mode():
 for s,(qi,ql) in qs.items():
  sample=stratified_sample(ql,32,8081); q=raw[qi[sample]].cuda(); labels=ql[sample].cuda(); pi,pl=gs[s]; p=rgb[pi].cuda(); pl=pl.cuda()
  ids,values=nearest_words(p,target,8)
  bank=term_average(source,torch.arange(len(target),device=q.device),ids,values,8,.03)
  out[s]={}
  for key,cov in [('paired',within),('shuffled',wrong)]:
   eig,v=torch.linalg.eigh(cov)
   for power in [0,.25,.5,1.]:
    weights=(1.+eig.clamp_min(0)/eig.mean()).pow(-.5*power)
    query=F.normalize((q@v)*weights); code=F.normalize((bank@v)*weights)
    k=200 if s=='sketchy_2' else 100; top=(query@code.T).topk(k).indices
    out[s][key+'_'+str(power)]=round(100*(pl[top]==labels[:,None]).float().mean().item(),4)
  print(s,out[s],flush=True)
(w/'results/residual-study/paired-scatter-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))

view-error-diagnosis.python:
from pathlib import Path
import json,torch
from torch.nn import functional as F
from tf_sbir.retrieval_diagnosis import global_inputs,stratified_sample
from tf_sbir.reverse_prompt import PhotoIndex,Setting
from tf_sbir.residual_benchmark import get_views
from tf_sbir.semantic import read_words
from tf_sbir.foundation import load_words
from tf_sbir.encoding import global_cache_name
w=Path('/content/sbir'); root=w/'results'
cfg,qp,qs,_,gs,raw,photos=global_inputs(w,'sketchy')
words=load_words(cfg,read_words(cfg.vocabulary))
ordinary=get_views(cfg,qp,'sketch')
geo=torch.load(cfg.cache/global_cache_name(cfg.root,qp,'sketch','spectral-clip-box-v1','fp16',cfg.clip_checkpoint),map_location='cpu',weights_only=True,mmap=True)
locked=json.loads((root/'reverse-prompt-diffusion/freeze.json').read_text())
method=Setting(**locked['winner']); report={}
with torch.inference_mode():
 for s,(qi,ql) in qs.items():
  pi,pl=gs[s]; index=PhotoIndex(photos[pi].cuda(),*(x.cuda() for x in words))
  choice=stratified_sample(ql,40,60619); ids=qi[choice]; labels=ql[choice].cuda(); gallery_labels=pl.cuda()
  def item(query):
   values=[]
   for block in index.scores(query,method):
    top=block.topk(200 if s=='sketchy_2' else 100).indices
    begin=sum(len(x) for x in values)
    hit=gallery_labels[top].eq(labels[begin:begin+len(block),None])
    values.append(torch.stack((hit[:,0].float(),hit.float().mean(1)),1))
   return torch.cat(values)
  ref=item(raw[ids].cuda()); variants={}
  for name,features in [('mirror',ordinary[ids,0]),('center_180',ordinary[ids,1]),('center_144',ordinary[ids,3]),('object',geo['features'][ids,0]),('padded',geo['features'][ids,1]),('size_center',geo['features'][ids,6]),('same_size_opposite',geo['features'][ids,11])]:
   cur=item(F.normalize(features.cuda().float()))
   variants[name]=cur
  box=geo['boxes'][ids,0].float(); area=(box[:,2:]-box[:,:2]).prod(1); disp=((box[:,2:]+box[:,:2])/2-.5).norm(dim=1)
  blind=ref[:,0]==0; anyfix=torch.stack([v[:,0] for v in variants.values()]).amax(0)>0
  report[s]={'queries':len(choice),'native_locked_reference_P':float(ref[:,1].mean()),'top1_wrong':int(blind.sum()),'oracle_view_rescues':int((blind&anyfix).sum()),
  'median_bbox_area':float(area.median()),'mean_bbox_offset':float(disp.mean()),'variants':{k:{'P':float(v[:,1].mean()),'rescued_top1':int((blind & v[:,0].bool()).sum()),'lost_top1':int((~blind & ~v[:,0].bool()).sum())} for k,v in variants.items()},
  'area_quartiles':[{'queries':len(ix),'area':float(area[ix].mean()),'object_P':float(variants['object'][ix,1].mean()),'center_P':float(variants['size_center'][ix,1].mean()),'ref_P':float(ref[ix,1].mean())} for ix in area.argsort().tensor_split(4)]}
  print(s,report[s],flush=True)
(root/'residual-study/view-error-diagnosis.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

vocabulary-discovery-probe.python:
from pathlib import Path
import json,torch
from torch.nn import functional as F
from tf_sbir.retrieval_diagnosis import global_inputs,stratified_sample
from tf_sbir.reverse_prompt import nearest_words,term_average
from tf_sbir.semantic import read_words
from tf_sbir.foundation import load_words
from tf_sbir.reranking import standardize
w=Path('/content/sbir');a,qp,qs,pp,gs,raw,photos=global_inputs(w,'sketchy')
src,tgt=(x.cuda() for x in load_words(a,read_words(a.vocabulary))); out={}
with torch.inference_mode():
 for s,(qi,ql) in qs.items():
  sel=stratified_sample(ql,40,5263); pi,pl=gs[s]; q=raw[qi[sel]].cuda();p=photos[pi].cuda(); y=ql[sel].cuda();z=pl.cuda()
  ids,values=nearest_words(p,tgt,16); d=len(tgt)
  mass=torch.bincount(ids.flatten(),weights=(values/.02).softmax(1).flatten(),minlength=d)
  original=term_average(src,torch.arange(d,device='cuda'),ids,values,8,.03); direct=standardize(q@original.T)
  table={}
  def prec(score):
   k=200 if s=='sketchy_2' else 100
   return round(float((z[score.topk(k).indices]==y[:,None]).float().mean())*100,3)
  table['direct']=prec(direct)
  for m in (16,32,64,128,256,512,1024):
   terms=mass.topk(m).indices
   weighted=(p@tgt[terms].T/.02).softmax(1)
   restricted=standardize(q@F.normalize(weighted@src[terms]).T)
   px=(q@src[terms].T/.02).softmax(1)
   likelihood=standardize((px@(weighted/weighted.mean(0).clamp_min(1e-9).sqrt()).T).clamp_min(1e-15).log())
   table[str(m)]=[prec(restricted),prec(likelihood),prec(.5*restricted+.5*direct)]
  out[s]=table; print(s,table,flush=True)
(w/'results/residual-study/vocabulary-discovery-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
